Following today's "surprise reveal" event, Apple has updated its official Design Resources website to include new product frame assets for the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro. Here are the details.

iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro frame assets are now available

Designers should be familiar with the Apple Design Resources website, which provides various hardware and software assets for them to use in their own work.

These assets include Figma, Sketch, Photoshop, PDF, PNG, and SVG files for Apple platforms, products, and technologies, as well as fonts, SF Symbols, Apple's Icon Composer, and badges and logos for services such as Apple Health and Apple Wallet.

After announcing the iPhone Duo and iPhone 18 Pro today, Apple has updated the Design Resources website to add Photoshop and PNG assets for these two new devices.

The assets include both the open and folded form factors of the iPhone Duo, as well as versions in two colours, along with the iPhone 18 Pro model featuring a smaller Dynamic Island.

To check out the new frame assets and other existing assets on the Apple Design Resources website, click here.
